bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
cid=gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
compose=/home/gace/.local/share/gace-create-videobot/native-sticker-c8c50d420c0b9b5d447a1fc87ef3d9e1ec7aceed/deploy/compose.videobot.poll.yaml
tag=gace-createvdobot-paidlock-ack-20261123
test -f "$compose" && test ! -L "$compose" || { echo COMPOSE_INVALID; exit 70; }
test "$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.State.Running}}')" = true || exit 71
original="$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.Image}}')"
staged="$(docker image inspect "$tag" --format '{{.Id}}')" || exit 72
test "$original" != "$staged" || { echo IMAGE_ALREADY_ACTIVE; exit 73; }
python3 - "$compose" <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import sys,re
text=Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text()
pattern=r'(?m)^[ \t]*image:[ \t]*create-videobot:video-sale-1695-receipt-fixed[ \t]*$'
if len(re.findall(pattern,text))!=1:raise SystemExit('COMPOSE_BASE_IMAGE_NOT_EXACT')
PY
backup="$compose.before-paidlock-ack-20261123"
test ! -e "$backup" || { echo BACKUP_ALREADY_PRESENT; exit 74; }
cp -p "$compose" "$backup"
activated=0
rollback(){
  code=$?
  if test "$activated" = 1; then
    cp -p "$backup" "$compose"
    docker compose -f "$compose" -p gace-createvdobot up -d --no-deps --force-recreate videobot-poll >/dev/null || true
  fi
  exit "$code"
}
trap rollback ERR
python3 - "$compose" <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re,sys,os
p=Path(sys.argv[1]);s=p.read_text()
pattern=r'(?m)^([ \t]*image:[ \t]*)create-videobot:video-sale-1695-receipt-fixed([ \t]*)$'
ns,n=re.subn(pattern,r'\1gace-createvdobot-paidlock-ack-20261123\2',s)
if n!=1:raise SystemExit('COMPOSE_EXPECTED_EXACTLY_ONE')
tmp=p.with_name(p.name+'.paidlock-stage')
with open(tmp,'x') as f:
 f.write(ns);f.flush();os.fsync(f.fileno())
os.chmod(tmp,p.stat().st_mode & 0o777)
os.replace(tmp,p)
PY
activated=1
docker compose -f "$compose" -p gace-createvdobot config --quiet
docker compose -f "$compose" -p gace-createvdobot up -d --no-deps --force-recreate videobot-poll >/dev/null
test "$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.State.Running}}')" = true
test "$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.Image}}')" = "$staged"
docker exec "$cid" node --input-type=module -e 'import {publishVideoListing} from "/opt/videobot/src/telegram/paidListingPublisher.mjs"; if(typeof publishVideoListing!=="function")process.exit(2);'
test "$(docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -c '^gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1$')" = 1
trap - ERR
echo "PAIDLOCK_ACK_GUARD_DEPLOYED=PASS"
echo "PAIDLOCK_ACTIVE_IMAGE=$staged"
echo "PAIDLOCK_PREVIOUS_IMAGE=$original"
echo "PAIDLOCK_COMPOSE_BACKUP=$backup"
